verses.sanskrit:
सञ्जय उवाच।
              प्रायोपविष्टे तु हते पुत्रे सात्यकिना तदा।  सोमद‌त्तो भृशं क्रुद्धः सात्यकिं वाक्यमब्रवीत्॥१॥
क्षत्रधर्मः पुरा दृष्टो यस्तु देवैर्महात्मभिः।  तं त्वं सात्वत सन्त्यज्य दस्युधर्मे कथं रतः॥२॥
पराङ्मुखाय दीनाय न्यस्तशस्त्रायं सात्यके।  क्षत्रधर्मरतः प्राज्ञः कथं नु प्रहरेद्रणे॥३॥
verses.english: How can a wise person, practising the Kshatriya duties, strike in battle one who runs away or is helpless or has laid aside his weapons or who begs (for his life)?

verses.sanskrit: द्वावेव किल वृष्णीनां तत्र ख्यातौ महारथौ। प्रद्युम्नश्च महाबाहुस्त्वं चैव युधि सात्वत॥४॥
verses.english: O Satvata, it is said that among the Vrishnis there are two principal and mighty car-warriors in battle, namely, the highly highly energetic Pradyumna and yourself.

verses.sanskrit: कथं प्रायोपविष्टाय पार्थेन छिन्नबाहवे।  नृशंसं पतनीयं च तादृशं कृतवानसि॥५॥
verses.english: Why then did you practise such a cruelty and commit such an act, that would lead to your downfall, towards one that had sat in prayer and whose arms had been cut-off by Partha?

verses.sanskrit: कर्मणस्तस्य दुर्वृत्त फलं प्राप्नुहि संयुगे।  अद्य च्छेत्स्यामि ते मूढ शिरो विक्रम्य पत्रिणा॥६॥
verses.english: 0 wicked one, suffer (now) the consequences of that act of yours in battle. Exerting my strength, O fool, I will today cutoff your head with arrows?

verses.sanskrit: शपे सात्वतपुत्राभ्यामिष्टेन सुकृतेन च।  अनतीतामिमां रात्रिं यदि त्वां वीरमानिनम्॥७॥
अरक्ष्यमाणं पार्थेन जिष्णुना ससुतानुजम्।  न हन्यान्नरके घोरे पतेयं वृष्णिपांसन॥८॥
एवमुक्त्वा सुसंक्रुद्धः सोमदत्तो महाबलः।  दध्मौ शङ्खं च तारेण सिंहनादं ननाद च॥९॥
ततः कमलपत्राक्षः सिंहदंष्ट्रो दुरासदः।  सात्यकिर्भृशसंक्रुद्धः सोमदत्तमथाब्रवीत्॥१०॥
verses.english: Then the greatly powerful Satyaki endued with eyes (beautiful) as lotus petals and possessed of leonine teeth greatly enraged thus addressed Somadatta.

verses.sanskrit: कौरवेय न मे त्रासः कथंचिदपि विद्यते।  त्वया सार्धमथान्यैश्च युध्यतो हृदि कश्चन॥११॥
verses.english: "O descendant of the Kurus, I entertain not the least fear in my heart whether fighting with you or with others.

verses.sanskrit: यदि सर्वेण सैन्येन गुप्तो मां योधयिष्यसि।  तथापि न व्यथा काचित्त्वयि स्यान्मम कौरव॥१२॥
verses.english: I shall not experience the slightest pain, even if backed up by all your forces you fight with me, Oscion of the Kuru race.

verses.sanskrit: युद्धसारेण वाक्येन असतां संमतेन च।  नाहं भीषयितुं शक्यः क्षत्रवृत्ते स्थितस्त्वया॥१३॥
verses.english: Observant of the practices of the Kshatriyas as I am, I can to be terrified with words smelling of battle and insulting to the virtuous.

verses.sanskrit: यदि तेऽस्ति युयुत्साऽद्य मया सह नराधिप।  निर्दयो निशितैर्बाणैः प्रहर प्रहरामि ते॥१४॥
हतो भूरिश्रवा वीरस्तव पुत्रो महारथः।  शलश्चैव महाराज भ्रातृव्यसनकर्षितः॥१५॥
verses.english: O king, your son, the mighty car-warrior Bhurisrava has been slain. Then the heroic Shala and Vrisena too have been destroyed.

verses.sanskrit: त्वां चाप्यद्य वधिष्यामि सहपुत्रं सबान्धवम्।  तिष्ठेदानीं रणे यत्तः कौरवोऽसि महारथः॥१६॥
verses.english: I will today destroy you also together with your sons and friends, you are a descendant of the Kuru race and are endued with great prowess. Now remain carefully in battle.

verses.sanskrit: यस्मिन्दानं दमः शौचमहिंसा ह्रीर्धृतिः क्षमा।  अनपायानि सर्वाणि नित्यं राज्ञियुधिष्ठिरे॥१७॥
मृदङ्गकेतोस्तस्य त्वं तेजसा निहतः पुरा।  सकर्णसौबलः संख्ये विनाशसुपयास्यसि॥१८॥
verses.bhavadeepa: दानम् - स्वद्रव्यस्य परस्वत्वापादनम् । दमो - मनसो यथेष्टं विनियोगयोग्यता । शौचम् - सङ्करवर्जनम् । अहिंसा -  सर्वभूतानामनभिद्रोहः । ह्रीः -अकर्तव्यान्निवर्तको धर्मः । क्षमा - अपकारिण्यकोपः ॥१७॥

verses.sanskrit: शपेऽहं कृष्णचरणैरिष्टापूर्तेन चैव ह।  यदि त्वां ससुतं पापं न हन्यां युधि रोषितः॥१९॥
अपयास्यसि चेत्युक्त्वा रणं मुक्तो भविष्यसि।  एवमाभाष्य चान्योन्यं क्रोधसंरक्तलोचनौ॥२०॥
verses.english: If, however, you run away (from the field), you may be freed (from me).' Thus addressing each other, with eyes reddened with rage.

verses.sanskrit: प्रवृत्तौ शरसंपातं कर्तुं पुरुषसत्तमौ। ततो रथसहस्त्रेण नागानामयुतेन च॥२१॥
verses.english: Those two foremost of men began to discharge arrows (at each other, Then with a thousand cars and ten thousand cars and ten thousand horses.

verses.sanskrit: दुर्योधनः सोमदत्तं परिवार्य समन्ततः। शकुनिश्च सुसंक्रुद्धः सर्वशस्त्रभृतां वरः॥२२॥
verses.english: Duryodhana stood surrounding Somadatta. Shakuni, too excited with wrath and armed with all the weapons.

verses.sanskrit: पुत्रपौत्रैः परिवृतो भ्रातृभिश्चेन्द्रविक्रमैः। स्यालस्तव महाबाहुर्वज्रसंहननो युवा॥२३॥
verses.english: And surrounded by sons and grandsons and brother powerful as Indra himself (followed Duryodhana's example), Your youthful brother-in-low. O king, endued with a body hard as the thunderbolt.

verses.sanskrit: साग्रं शतसहस्रं तु हयानां तस्य धीमतः। सोमदत्तं महेष्वासं समन्तात्पर्यरक्षत॥२४॥
verses.english: And gifted with wisdom and who had with him one hundred thousand steeds of best breed, completely hemmed in that mighty bowman Somadatta.

verses.sanskrit: रक्ष्यमाणश्च बलिभिश्छादयामास सात्यकिम्। तं छाद्यमानं विशिखैर्दृष्ट्वा सन्नतपर्वभिः॥२५॥
धृष्टद्युम्नोऽभ्ययात्क्रुद्धः प्रगृह्य महतीं चमूम्। चण्डवाताभिसृष्टानामुदधीनामिव स्वनः॥२६॥
verses.english: Dhristadyumna, followed by a large army, proceeded wrathfully (towards him). Like the roar of waters dashed into fury by a terrible hurricane.

verses.sanskrit: आसीद्राजन्बलौघानामन्योन्यमभिनिघ्नताम्।  विव्याध सोमदत्तस्तु सात्वतं नवभिः शरैः॥२७॥
verses.english: There arose, O king, a great tumult among the (two) forces striking each other. Somadatta then pierced Satvata with nine arrows.

verses.sanskrit: सात्यकिर्नवभिश्चैनमवधीत्कुरुपुङ्गवम्।  सोऽतिविद्धो बलवता समरे दृढधन्विना॥२८॥
verses.english: Satyaki too pierced that foremost of Kurus with nine shafts. Deeply wounded in battle by that powerful and firm wielder of bow.

verses.sanskrit: रथोपस्थं समासाद्य मुमोह गतचेतनः।  तं विमूढं समालक्ष्य सारथिस्त्वरया युतः॥२९॥
verses.english: (Somadatta) leaned against the terrace of his car and (then) swooned away and was deprived of consciousness. Seeing that he was deprived of consciousness, his charioteer, in great hurry.

verses.sanskrit: अपोवाह रणाद्वीरं सोमदत्तं महारथम्।  तं विसंज्ञं समालक्ष्य युयुधानशरार्दितम्॥३०॥
verses.english: Carried away the heroic and mighty carwarrior Somadatta from (the field of) battle. Beholding him deprived of senses and afflicted with the arrows of Yuyudhana.

verses.sanskrit: अभ्यद्रवत्ततो द्रोणो यदुवीरजिघांसया।  तमायान्तमभिप्रेक्ष्य युधिष्ठिरपुरोगमाः॥३१॥
verses.english: Drona desirous of slaying the heroic (Yadu rushed (at him). Seeing (i.e. Drona advance), Yudhishthira (putting himself) at the head (of his troops).

verses.sanskrit: परिवव्रुर्महात्मानं परीप्सन्तो यदूत्तमम्।  ततः प्रववृते युद्धं द्रोणस्य सह पाण्डवैः॥३२॥
verses.english: With the desire of rescuing the high-souled perpetuator of the Yadu race surrounded him on all sides. Then there commenced a battle between Drona and the Pandavas,

verses.sanskrit: बलेरिव सुरैः पूर्वं त्रैलोक्यजयकाङ्क्षया।  ततः सायकजालेन पाण्डवानीकमावृणोत्॥३३॥
verses.english: Like that (which took place) in days of yore between Bali and the celestials (both) desirous of the conquest of the three worlds. Then covering the Pandava army with arrowy showers.

verses.sanskrit: भारद्वाजो महातेजा विव्याध च युधिष्ठिरम्।  सात्यकिं दशभिर्बाणैर्विंशत्या पार्षतं शरैः॥३४॥
verses.english: The highly-energetic son of Bharadvaja pierced Yudhishthira also. (Drona then struck) Satyaki with ten darts and the son of Prishata (i.e. Dhristadyumna) with twenty five darts.

verses.sanskrit: भीमसेनं च नवभिर्नकुलं पञ्चभिस्तथा।  सहदेवं तथाऽष्टाभिः शतेन च शिखण्डिनम्॥३५॥
verses.english: (And he pierced) Bhimasena with nine, Nakula with five, Sahadeva with eight and Shikhandi with one hundred arrows.

verses.sanskrit: द्रौपदेयान्महाबाहुः पञ्चभिः पञ्चभिः शरैः। विराटं मत्स्यमष्टाभिर्द्रुपदं दशभिः शरैः॥३६॥
verses.english: That mighty armed one (then pierced) each of (the five) sons of Draupadi with five arrows, Virata the king of Matsyas with eight, Drupada with ten darts.

verses.sanskrit: युधामन्युं त्रिभिः षड्भिरुत्तमौजसमाहवे।  अन्यांश्च सैनिकान्विद्ध्वा युधिष्ठिरमुपाद्रवत्॥३७॥
verses.english: Yudhamanu with three and Uttamanja with six (arrows) in that battle. (Similarly) piercing many other soldiers (he) rushed against Yudhishthira.

verses.sanskrit: ते वध्यमाना द्रोणेन पाण्डुपुत्रस्य सैनिकाः।  प्राद्रवन्वै भयाद्राजन् सार्तनादा दिशो दश॥३८॥
verses.english: (Thus) struck by Drona, the troops of the son of Pandu with loud wails fled away in terror in ten directions, O king.

verses.sanskrit: काल्यमानं तु तत्सैन्यं दृष्ट्वा द्रोणेन फाल्गुनः।  किञ्चिदागतसंरंभो गुरुं पार्थोऽभ्ययाद्द्रुतम्॥३९॥
verses.english: Seeing that are army was being slaughtered by Drona, Phalguna Partha, enraged a little, advanced speedily against his preceptor.

verses.sanskrit: दृष्ट्वा द्रोणस्तु बीभत्सुमभिधावन्तमाहवे। संन्यवर्तत तत्सैन्यं पुनर्यौधिष्ठिरं बलम्॥४०॥
verses.english: O king, beholding that Drona too was advancing against Vibhatsu in that battle, the soldiers of Yudhishthira rallied again.

verses.sanskrit: ततो युद्धमभूद्भूयो भारद्वाजस्य पाण्डवैः। द्रोणस्तव सुतै राजन्सर्वतः परिवारितः॥४१॥
verses.english: Then again commenced a battle between the sons of Bharadvaja and the Pandavas. Drona, O king, completely surrounded by your sons.

verses.sanskrit: व्यधमत्पाण्डुसैन्यानि तूलराशिमिवानलः। तं ज्वलन्तमिवादित्यं दीप्तानलसमद्युतिम्॥४२॥
verses.english: Began to destroy the troops of the Pandavas, as fire (consumes) a heap of cotton. (He then) looked like the radiant sun and was endued with the resplendence of a blazing fire.

verses.sanskrit: राजन्ननिशमत्यन्तं दृष्ट्वा द्रोणं शरार्चिषम्। मण्डलीकृतधन्वानं तपन्तमिव भास्करम्॥४३॥
verses.english: O king, seeing Drona incessantly discharge fierce arrows like sparks of fire from his bow drawn to a circle and like the scorching sun.

verses.sanskrit: दहन्तमहितान्सैन्ये नैनं कश्चिदवारयत्। यो यो हि प्रमुखे तस्य तस्थौ द्रोणस्य पूरुषः॥४७॥
verses.english: Consume the evenings there was none among the arıny that could withstand him. Those persons who stood before Drona (in order to resist him).

verses.sanskrit: तस्य तस्य शिरश्छित्त्वा ययुर्दोणशराः क्षितिम्। एवं सा पाण्डवी सेना वध्यमाना महात्मना॥४८॥
verses.english: Had their heads cut-off by Drona with arrows which (then) entered into the earth. The army of the Pandavas thus slaughtered by that high-souled one.

verses.sanskrit: प्रदुद्राव पुनर्भीता पश्यतः सव्यसाचिनः।  संप्रभग्नं चलं दृष्ट्वा द्रोणेन निशि भारत॥४९॥
verses.english: Again ran away in terror (even) in the very sight of Savyasachi. Seeing his lines broken by Drona at (that) night, O Bharata.

verses.sanskrit: गोविन्दमब्रवीज्जिष्णुर्गच्छ द्रोणरथं प्रति। ततो रजत-रजत-गोक्षीर-कुन्देन्दुसदृशप्रभान्॥५०॥
verses.english: Jishnu said to Govinda "proceed towards the car of Drona.” Then that Dasarha (chief) drove the horses, looking like silver or milk of cows or like the Kunda flower, towards the car of Drona. Sceing that Phalguna was proceeding towards Drona, Bhimasena too.

verses.sanskrit: चोदयामास दाशार्हो हयान्द्रोणरथं प्रति।  भीमसेनोऽपि तं दृष्ट्वा यान्तं द्रोणाय फाल्गुनम्॥५१॥
स्वसारथिमुवाचेदं द्रोणानीकाय मां वह।  सोऽपि तस्य वचः श्रुत्वा विशोको वाहयद्धयान्॥५२॥
verses.english: Ordered his own charioteer to take him towards Drona's troops. Visaka (the charioteer of Bhima), hearing those words of his (master) guided the steeds.

verses.sanskrit: ततो राजन्नभूद्घोरः संग्रामो लोमहर्षणः।  बीभत्सुर्दक्षिणं पार्श्वमुत्तरं च वृकोदरः॥५२॥
verses.english: Ordered his own charioteer to take him towards Drona's troops. Visaka (the charioteer of Bhima), hearing those words of his (master) guided the steeds.

verses.sanskrit: पृष्ठतः सत्यसन्धस्य जिष्णोर्भरतसत्तम।  तौ दृष्ट्वा भ्रातरौ यत्तौ द्रोणानीकमभिद्रुतौ ॥५३॥
verses.english: Behind Jishnu of unerring aim, O foremost of the Bharatas. Seeing those two brothers resolutely rush towards Drona's division.

verses.sanskrit: महद्भ्यां रथवृन्दाभ्यां बलं जगृहतुस्तव।  तौ दृष्ट्वा पुरुषव्याघ्रौ भीमसेनधनञ्जयौ॥५३॥
verses.english: Behind Jishnu of unerring aim, O foremost of the Bharatas. Seeing those two brothers resolutely rush towards Drona's division.

verses.sanskrit: पञ्चालाः सृञ्जया मत्स्याश्चेदिकारूषकोसलाः।  अन्वगच्छन्महाराज केकयाश्च महारथाः॥५४॥
verses.english: The Panchalas, the Srinjayas, the Matsyas, the Chedis, the Kauravas, the Kosalas and those mighty car-warriors, the Keykayas followed suit, O great king.

verses.sanskrit: धृष्टद्युम्नोऽभ्ययाद्राजन् सात्यकिश्च महाबलः।  चण्डवाताभिपन्नानामुदधीनामिव स्वनः॥५४॥
verses.english: The Panchalas, the Srinjayas, the Matsyas, the Chedis, the Kauravas, the Kosalas and those mighty car-warriors, the Keykayas followed suit, O great king.

verses.sanskrit: आसीद्राजन्बलौघानां तदाऽन्योन्यमभिघ्नताम्।  सौमदत्तिवधात्क्रुद्धो दृष्ट्वा सात्यकिमाहवे॥५५॥
verses.english: There arose a great tumult among the combatants striking each other. Seeing Satyaki in battle and enraged at the slaughter of the son of Somadatta,

verses.sanskrit: द्रौणिरभ्यद्रवद्राजन्वधाय कृतनिश्चयः। तमापतन्तं संप्रेक्ष्य शैनेयस्य रथं प्रति॥५६॥
verses.english: The son of Drona rushed furiously against Satvatta at the van of battle. (Seeing) him proceed towards the car of the grandson of Sini in battle.

verses.sanskrit: भैमसेनिः सुसंक्रुद्धः प्रत्यभित्रमवारयत्।  कार्ष्णायसं महाघोरमृक्षचर्मपरिच्छदम्॥५७॥
verses.english: That gigantic Rakshasa, the of Bhimasena, possessed of enormous strength, rushed (at him) inounted on a huge and awfully dreadful car made of black iron covered with bear-skin, measuring thirty Nalvas in height and width, furnished with various machines and emitting thundering roars like those of a mighty (mass of) clouds.

verses.sanskrit: महान्तं रथमास्थाय त्रिंशन्नल्वांतरान्तरम्।  विक्षिप्तयन्त्रसन्नाहं महामेघौघनिःस्वनम्॥५८॥
युक्तं गजनिभैर्वाहैर्न हयैर्नापि वारणैः।  विक्षिप्तपक्षचरणविवृताक्षेण कूजता॥५९॥
verses.english: (And it was) drawn by animals looking like elephants; but they were neither elephants nor horses. With its wings and feet outstretched son and with expanded eyes and emitting (terrible) shrieks.

verses.sanskrit: ध्वजेनोच्छ्रितदण्डेन गृध्रराजेन राजितम्।  लोहितार्द्रपताकं तु अन्त्रमालाविभूषितम्॥६०॥
verses.english: A prince of vultures sat on its towering standard. (That car) was adorned with red flags furnished with rows of bones.
verses.bhavadeepa: न हयैर्नापि वारणैर्गजैः किं तु पिशाचैः ॥५९॥

verses.sanskrit: अष्टचक्रसमायुक्तमास्थाय विपुलं रथम्।  शूलमुद्गरधारिण्या शैलपादपहस्तया॥६१॥
verses.english: And with eight wheels. (And he) sat down on this car surrounding by one Akshauhini of terrible-looking Rakshasa armed with maces and clubs and carrying rocks an trees in their hands. The kings were (greatly) pained on seeing him (to advance) with upraised bow.

verses.sanskrit: रक्षसां घोररूपाणामक्षौहिण्या समावृतः।  तमुद्यतमहाचापं निशम्य व्यथिता नृपाः॥६२॥
युगान्तकालसमये दण्डहस्तमिवान्तकम्।  ततस्तं गिरिशृङ्गाभं भीमरूपं भयावहम्॥६३॥
verses.english: Look like the very destroyer himself, mace in hand, at the time of universal dissolution. (And he) resembled a mountain peak, was frightful to look at and dreadful.

verses.sanskrit: दंष्ट्राकरालोग्रमुखं शंकुकर्णं महाहनुम्।  ऊर्ध्वकेशं विरूपाक्षं दीप्तास्यं निम्नितोदरम्॥६४॥
verses.english: (He) had terrible teeth and a dreadful face, was possessed of arrow-like ears, high cheek bones, shooting hair, un-natural eyes, flaming mouth and a sunken belly.

verses.sanskrit: महाश्वभ्रगलद्वारं किरीटच्छन्नमूर्धजम्।  त्रासनं सर्वभूतानां व्यात्ताननमिवान्तकम्॥६५॥
verses.english: His oesophagus was deep as a yawning pit and his head was furnished with a coronet. He was dreadful to all creatures and his jaws were as wide as those of the Destroyer himself.

verses.sanskrit: वीक्ष्य दीप्तमिवायान्तं रिपुविक्षोभकारिणम्।  तमुद्यतमहाचापं राक्षसेन्द्रं घटोत्कचम्॥६६॥
verses.english: Seeing Gatotkacha, the lord of the Rakshasas endued with splendour and capable of striking terror into foes, advance upraising his great bow.

verses.sanskrit: भयार्दिता प्रचुक्षोभ पुत्रस्य तव वाहिनी।  वायुना क्षोभितावर्ता गङ्गेवोर्ध्वतरङ्गिणी॥६७॥
घटोत्कचप्रयुक्तेन सिंहनादेन भीषिताः।  प्रसुस्रुवुर्गजा मूत्रं विव्यथुश्च नरा भृशम्॥६८॥
ततोऽश्मवृष्टिरत्यर्थमासीत्तत्र समन्ततः।  सन्ध्याकालाधिकबलैः प्रयुक्ता राक्षसैः क्षितौ॥६९॥
आयसानि च चक्राणि भुशुण्ड्यः प्रास-तोमराः।  पतन्त्यविरताः शूलाः शतघ्न्यः पट्टिशास्तथा॥७०॥
verses.english: Showers of iron, wheels, Bhushundis, arrows, spears, Sataghness and axes also began to fall there incessantly.

verses.sanskrit: तदुग्रमतिरौद्रं च दृष्ट्वा युद्धं नराधिपाः।  तनयास्तव कर्णश्च व्यथिताः प्राद्रवन्दिशः॥७१॥
तत्रैकोऽस्त्रवलश्लाघी द्रौणिर्मानी न विव्यथे।  व्यधमच्च शरैर्मायां घटोत्कचविनिर्मिताम्॥७२॥
verses.english: There the haughty son, of Drona only proud of his prowess in weapons, stood without fear (and he) soon did away with the illusion created by Ghatotkacha.

verses.sanskrit: विहतायां तु मायायाममर्षी स घटोत्कचः।  विससर्ज शरान्घोरांस्तेश्वत्थामानमाविशन्॥७३॥
verses.english: Enraged at the illusion being dispelled (by the son of Drona), Ghatotkacha began to discharge fierce arrows. Those (arrows) penetrated into (the body of) Asvatthama. As snakes insensible with rage furiously (enter into) an ant-hill, those arrows penetrating through (the body of) the son of Saradvata became covered with blood.

verses.sanskrit: भुजङ्गा इव वेगेन वल्मीकं क्रोधमूर्च्छिताः।  ते शरा रुधिराक्ताङ्गा भित्त्वा शारद्वतीसुतम्॥७४॥
विविशुर्धरणीं शीघ्रा रुक्मपुङ्खाः शिलाशिताः।  अश्वत्थामा तु संक्रुद्धो लघुहस्तः प्रतापवान्॥७५॥
घटोत्कचमभिक्रुद्धं बिभेद दशभिः शरैः।  घटोत्कचोऽतिविद्धस्तु द्रोणपुत्रेण मर्मसु॥७६॥
चक्रं शतसहस्त्रारमगृह्णाद्व्यथितो भृशम्।  क्षुरान्तं बालसूर्याभं मणिवज्रविभूषितम्॥७७॥
verses.english: Became greatly afflicted and then took up a wheel furnished with one hundred thousand spokes. (this wheel) the edge of which was sharp as that of a razor and which was as resplendent as the morning sun and was studded with gems and precious stones.

verses.sanskrit: अश्वत्थाम्नि स चिक्षेप भैमसेनिर्जिघांसया।  वेगेन महता गच्छद्विक्षिप्तं द्रौणिना शरैः॥७८॥
verses.english: Was hurled by the son of Bhimasena at Ashvatthama with the desire of slaying (him). cut-off into fragments by the son of Drona with arrows as it coursed with great speed (towards him).

verses.sanskrit: अभाग्यस्येव संकल्पस्तन्मोघमपतद्भुवि।  घटोत्कचस्ततस्तूर्णं दृष्ट्वा चक्रं निपातितम्॥७९॥
verses.english: If fell down on the ground like the purposes of an unlucky person. Seeing his wheel cut down, Ghatotkacha speedily.

verses.sanskrit: द्रौणिं प्राच्छादयद्बाणैः स्वर्भानुरिव भास्करम्।  घटोत्कचसुतः श्रीमान् भिन्नाञ्जनचयोपमः॥८०॥
verses.english: Covered the son of Drona with shafts as Sarbhanu (i.e. Rahu) swallows the creator of light (i.e. the sun). The resplendent son of Ghatotkacha resembling a mass of antimony.

verses.sanskrit: रुरोध द्रौणिमायान्तं प्रभञ्जनमिवाद्रिराट्।  पौत्रेण भीमसेनस्य शरैरञ्जनपर्वणा॥८१॥
verses.english: Arrested the advance of the son of Drona as the king of mountains (checks the career of) the wind. (Struck with arrows) by the heroic Anjanaparva, the grandson of Bhimasena.

verses.sanskrit: बभौ मेघेन धाराभिर्गिरिर्मेरुरिवावृतः।  अश्वत्थामा त्वसंभ्रान्तो रुद्रोपेन्द्रेन्द्रविक्रमः॥८२॥
verses.english: (The son of Drona) looked like the mountain Meru drenched with (copious) showers of rain from the clouds. Ashvatthama also endued with a prowess equal to that of Rudra or Upendra, becoming highly enraged.

verses.sanskrit: ध्वजमेकेन बाणेन चिच्छेदाञ्जनपर्वणः।  द्वाभ्यां तु रथयन्तारौ त्रिभिश्चास्य त्रिवेणुकम्॥८३॥
verses.english: Cut off the standard of Anjanaparva with one arrow, his two charioteers with two and his Trivenduka with four (arrows).

verses.sanskrit: धनुरेकेन चिच्छेद चतुर्भिश्चतुरो हयान्।  विरथस्योद्यतं हस्ताद्धेमबिन्दुभिराचितम्॥८४॥
verses.english: With one (arrow) he cut-off his bow and with four his four steeds. Deprived of his car, as he (i.e. the son of Ghatotkach) took up a scimitar studded with golden stars, in his hand and flourished it, (Ashvatthama) severed it into two parts of by a keen dart. Then, O king, the grandson of Hidimva speedily (took up) a mace decked with gold;

verses.sanskrit: विशिखेन सुतीक्ष्णेन खड्गमस्य द्विधाऽकरोत्।  गदां हेमाङ्गदां राजंस्तूर्णं हैडिम्बिसूनुना॥८५॥
भ्राम्योत्क्षिप्ता शरैः साऽपि द्रौणिनाभ्याहताऽपतत्।  ततोऽन्तरिक्षमुत्प्लुत्य कालमेघ इवोन्नदन्॥८६॥
ववर्षाञ्जनपर्वा स द्रुमवर्षं नभस्तलात्।  ततो मायाधरं द्रौणिर्घटोत्कचसुतं दिवि॥८७॥
मार्गणैरभिविव्याध घनं सूर्य इवांशुभिः। सोऽवतीर्य पुरस्तस्थौ रथे हेमविभूषिते॥८८॥
महीगत इवात्युग्रः श्रीमानञ्जनपर्वतः।  तमयस्मयवर्माणं द्रौणिर्भीमात्मजात्मजम्॥८९॥
verses.english: Looking like a high and beautiful mountain of antimony, descended to the earth, the son of Drona slew th the of Bhima's son, Anjanaparva, clad in armour as Maheshvara (killed) the Asura) Andhaka in days of yore. Seeing his son of enormous strength killed Ashvatthama.

verses.sanskrit: जघानाञ्जनपर्वाणं महेश्वर इवान्धकम्। अथ दृष्ट्वा हतं पुत्रमश्वत्थाम्ना महाबलम्॥९०॥
द्रौणेः सकाशमभ्येत्य रोषात्प्रज्वलिताङ्गदः।  प्राह वाक्यमसंभ्रान्तो वीरं शारद्वतीसुतम्॥९१॥
verses.english: (Ghatotkacha), the ornaments of whose arms were falling down from rage, came up to the son of Drona who consuming the Pandava army like a raging forest-fire and fearlessly

verses.sanskrit:
दहन्तं पाण्डवानीकं वनमग्निमिवोच्छ्रितम्।
              घटोत्कच उवाच।
              तिष्ठ तिष्ठ न मे जीवन्द्रोणपुत्र गमिष्यसि॥९२॥
verses.english: I am the Emperor of the Rakshasas and equal to the ten-necked (Ravana) in prowess. O son of Drona, wait, wait, you will never escape alive from me.

verses.sanskrit: त्वामद्य निहनिष्यामि क्रौञ्चमग्निसुतो यथा।  अश्वत्थामोवाच। गच्छ वत्स सहान्यैस्त्वं युध्यस्वामरविक्रम॥९३॥
verses.english: Ghatotkacha said O son of Drona, 'wait, wait.' You will not escape alive from me. I will today destroy you as the son of Angi (i.e. Kartikeya) rived the (mountain) Krouncha.

verses.sanskrit: न हि पुत्रेण हैडिम्बे पिता न्याय्यः प्रबाधितुम्।  कामं खलु न रोषो मे हैडिम्बे विद्यते त्वयि॥९४॥
verses.english: Ashvatthama said O son equal in prowess to a celestial, go and fight with others. O son of Hidimva, it is not proper for the father to fight with the son.

verses.sanskrit:
किं तु रोषान्वितो जन्तुर्हन्यादात्मानमप्युत।
              सञ्जय उवाच।
              श्रुत्वैतत्क्रोधताम्राक्षः पुत्रशोकसमन्वितः॥९५॥
verses.english: O son of Hidimva, I am in no way angry with you in my mind. But when a creature is excited with rage, it may (then) kill its own self.

verses.sanskrit: अश्वत्थामानमायस्तो भैमसेनिरभाषत। किमहं कातरो द्रौणे पृथग्जन इवाहवे॥९६॥
verses.bhavadeepa: आत्मानमपि हन्यात्किमु पुत्रमतो जीवनार्थी त्वं निवर्तस्वेति भावः ॥९५॥

verses.sanskrit: यन्मां भीषयसे वाग्भिरसदेतद्वचस्तव। भीमात्खलु समुत्पन्नः कुरूणां विपुले कुले॥९७॥
verses.english: “What! Am I like a common individual, unable to fight, O son of Drona, that you are terrifying me with words? These words of yeurs are (highly) improper.

verses.sanskrit: पाण्डवानामहं पुत्रः समरेष्वनिवर्तिनाम्। रक्षसामधिराजोऽहं दशग्रीवसमो बले॥९८॥
तिष्ठ तिष्ठ न मे जीवन्द्रोणपुत्र गमिष्यसि।  युद्धश्रद्धामहं तेऽद्य विनेष्यामि रणाजिरे॥९९॥
इत्युक्त्वा क्रोधताम्राक्षो राक्षसः सुमहाबलः।  द्रौणिमभ्यद्रवत्क्रुद्धो गजेन्द्रमिव केसरी॥१००॥
रथाक्षमात्रैरिषुभिरभ्यवर्षद्धटोत्कचः।  रथिनामृषभं द्रौणिं धाराभिरिव तोयदः॥१०१॥
शरवृश्टिं शरैर्द्रौणिरप्राप्तां तां व्यशातयत्।  ततोन्तरिक्षे बाणानां संग्रामोऽन्य इवाभवत्॥१०२॥
अथास्त्रसंमर्दकृतैर्विस्फुलिङ्गैस्तदा बभौ।  विभावरीमुखे व्योम खद्योतैरिव चित्रितम्॥१०३॥
verses.english: That the firmament was studded with glowworms during the night. Beholding his illusion destroyed by the son of Drona, proud (of his prowess) in battle.

verses.sanskrit: निशाम्य निहतां मायां द्रौणिना रणमानिना।  घटोत्कचस्ततो मायां ससर्जान्तर्हितः पुनः॥१०४॥
सोऽभवद्गिरिरत्युच्चः शिखरैस्तरुसङ्कटैः।  शूलप्रासासिमुसलजलप्रस्स्रवणो महान्॥१०५॥
verses.english: He then became a huge mountain with numerous peaks, covered with tall trees. From that mountain streams of lances, spears, swords and maces began to issue out incessantly.

verses.sanskrit: तमञ्जनगिरिप्रख्यं द्रौणिर्दृष्ट्वा महीधरम्।  प्रपतद्भिश्च बहुभिः शस्त्रसङ्घैर्न विव्यथे॥१०६॥
ततो हसन्निव द्रौणिर्वज्रमस्त्रमुदैरयत्।  स तेनास्त्रेण शैलेन्द्रः क्षिप्तः क्षिप्रं व्यनश्यत॥१०७॥
ततः स तोयदो भूत्वा नीलः सेन्द्रायुधो दिवि।  अश्मवृष्टिभिरत्युग्रो द्रौणिमाच्छादयद्रणे॥१०८॥
अथ सन्धाय वायव्यमस्त्रमस्त्रविदां वरः।  व्यधमद्द्रोणतनयो नीलमेघं समुत्थितम्॥१०९॥
स मार्गणगणैर्द्रौणिर्दिशः प्रच्छाद्य सर्वशः। शतं रथसहस्त्राणां जघान द्विपदां वरः॥११०॥
स दृष्ट्वा पुनरायान्तं रथेनायतकार्मुकम्।  घटोत्कचमसंभ्रान्तं राक्षसैर्बहुभिर्वृतम्॥१११॥
सिंहशार्दूलसदृशैर्मत्तद्विरद‌विक्रमैः।  गजस्थैश्च रथस्थैश्च वाजिपृष्ठगतैरपि॥११२॥
विकृतास्यशिरोग्रीवैर्हिडिम्बानुचरैः सह।  पौलस्त्यैर्यातुधानैश्च तामसैश्चेन्द्रविक्रमैः॥११३॥
नानाशस्त्रधरैर्वीरैर्नानाकवचभूषणैः।  महाबलैर्भीमरवैः संरंभोद्वृत्तलोचनैः॥११४॥
verses.english: Belonged to Pulasta and Yatudhana clans and like them, were (all) equal to Indra in prowess. (These Rakshasa) heroes wielded several (sorts of) armours.

verses.sanskrit: उपस्थितैस्ततो युद्धे राक्षसैर्युद्धदुर्मदैः। विषण्णमभिसंप्रेक्ष्य पुत्रं ते द्रौणिरब्रवीत्॥११५॥
तिष्ठ दुर्योधनाद्य त्वं न कार्यः संभ्रमस्त्वया।  सहैभिर्भातृभिर्वीरैः पार्थिवैश्चेन्द्रविक्रमैः॥११६॥
निहनिष्याम्यमित्रांस्ते न तवास्ति पराजयः।  सत्यं ते प्रतिजानामि पर्याश्वासय वाहिनीम्॥११७॥
verses.english: (Remain here) with your heroic brothers and with the kings equal in prowess to Indra himself. I will destroy your enemies. You will not meet with reverse; I tell you (this) truly. Now cheer up (your) army.

verses.sanskrit:
दुर्योधन उवाच।
              न त्वेतद‌द्भुतं मन्ये यत्ते महदिदं मनः।  अस्मासु च परा भक्तिस्तव गौतमिनन्दन॥११८॥
verses.english: Duryodhana said I do not deem it (i.e., what you say) wonderful because you have a large mind and (because), O son of Goutama's daughter, you are devotedly attached to us.

verses.sanskrit:
सञ्जय उवाच।
              अश्वत्थामानमुक्त्वैवं ततः सौबलमब्रवीत्। वृतं रथसहस्रेण हयानां रणशोभिनाम्॥११९॥
षष्ठ्या रथसहस्त्रैश्च प्रयाहि त्वं धनञ्जयम्।  कर्णश्च वृषसेनश्च कृपो नीलस्तथैव च॥१२०॥
verses.english: Do you mark against Dhananjaya with one thousand cars, Karna, Vrisasena, Kripa as well as Nila. as

verses.sanskrit: उदीच्याः कृतवर्मा च पुरुमित्रः सुतापनः।  दुःशासनो निकुंभश्च कुण्डभेदी पराक्रमः॥१२१॥
verses.english: And the warriors of the North, Kritavarma, the sons of Purumitra, Dusasana, Nikumva, Kundavedi, Purukrama.

verses.sanskrit: पुरञ्जयो दृढरथः पताकी हेमकम्पनः।  शल्यारुणींद्रसेनाश्च सञ्जयो विजयो जयः॥१२२॥
verses.english: And Puranjaya, Dridaratha, Pataki, Hemapusyaka, Shalya, Aruni, Indrasena, Sanjaya, Vijaya, Jaya.

verses.sanskrit: कमलाक्षः परक्राथी जयवर्मा सुदर्शनः।  एते त्वामनुयास्यन्ति पत्तीनामयुतानि षट्॥१२३॥
verses.english: And Kamalaksha, Parakrathi, Jayadharma, Sudarsana-(all) these will follow you together with sixty thousand infantry.

verses.sanskrit: जहि भीमं यमौ चोभौ धर्मराजं च मातुल।  असुरानिव देवेन्द्रो जयाशा मे त्वयि स्थिता॥१२४॥
verses.english: Destroy, O uncle, Bhima, the twins (i.e., Nakula and Sahadeva) as well the Dharmaraj, as the Asuras. My hope of success lies in you.

verses.sanskrit: दारितान्द्रौणिना बाणैर्भृशं विक्षतविग्रहान्।  जहि मातुल कौन्तेयानसुरानिव पावकिः॥१२५॥
एवमुक्तो ययौ शीघ्रं पुत्रेण तव सौबलः।  पिप्रीषुस्ते सुतान् राजन्दिधक्षुश्चैव पाण्डवान्॥१२६॥
अथ प्रववृते युद्धं द्रौणिराक्षसयोर्मृधे।  विभावर्यां सुतुमुलं शक्रप्रह्लाद‌दयोरिव॥१२७॥
verses.english: Then commenced on that night a dreadful encounter between the son of Drona and the Rakshasas (Ghatotkacha) like that (which had taken place in days of yore) between Shakra and Prahrada.

verses.sanskrit: ततो घटोत्कचो बाणैर्दशभिर्गौतमीसुतम्।  जघानोरसि संक्रुद्धो विषाग्निप्रतिमैर्दृढैः॥१२८॥
स तैरभ्याहतो गाढं शरैर्भीमसुतेरितैः।  चचाल रथमध्यस्थो वातोद्भूत इव द्रुमः॥१२९॥
भूयश्चाञ्जलिकेनाथ मार्गणेन महाप्रभम्।  द्रौणिहस्तस्थितं चापं चिच्छेदाशु घटोत्कचः॥१३०॥
verses.english: Again by means of a broad-headed shaft, Ghatotkacha soon cut-off that highly lustrous bow wielded by the son of Drona.

verses.sanskrit: ततोऽन्यद्द्रौणिरादाय धनुर्भारसहं महत्।  ववर्ष विशिखांस्तीक्ष्णान् वारिधारा इवांबुदः॥१३१॥
verses.english: Then taking up another strong bow capable of sustaining a great strain, the son of Drona poured showers of keen arrows as the clouds (pour down) showers of rain.

verses.sanskrit: ततः शारद्वतीपुत्रः प्रेषयामास भारत।  सुवर्णपुंखाञ्छत्रुघ्नान् खचरान् खचरं प्रति॥१३२॥
verses.english: Then, O Bharata, the son of Saradvati sent gold winged and sky-ranging destructive of foes against that ranger of the sky.

verses.sanskrit: तद्बाणैरर्दितं यूथं रक्षसां पीनवक्षसाम्।  सिंहैरिव बभौ मत्तं गजानामाकुलं कुलम्॥१३३॥
verses.english: That great host of the broad-chested Rakshasas, sore oppressed with his arrows, looked like a herd of furious elephants attacked) by a lion.

verses.sanskrit: विधम्य राक्षसान्बाणैः साश्वसूतरथद्विपान्।  ददाह भगवान्वह्निर्भूतानीव युगक्षये॥१३४॥
verses.english: Like the god Agni consuming the creatures at the end of a Yoga, he began to consume with his arrows the Rakshasas together with (their) horses, charioteers, cars and elephants. arrows

verses.sanskrit: स दग्ध्वाऽक्षौहिणीं बाणैर्नैर्ऋतीं रुरुचे नृप।  पुरेव त्रिपुरं दग्ध्वा दिवि देवो महेश्वरः॥१३५॥
verses.english: Consuming one Akshauhini of Rakshasa troops with his shafts, he shone like the divine Maheshvara in heaven when the latter had burnt down (the chief of) Tripura in days of yore.

verses.sanskrit: युगान्ते सर्वभूतानि दग्ध्वेव वसुरुल्बणः।  रराज जयतां श्रेष्ठो द्रोणपुत्रस्तवाहितान्॥१३६॥
ततो घटोत्कचः क्रुद्धो रक्षसां भीमकर्मणाम्।  द्रौणिं हतेति महतीं चोदयामास तां चमूम्॥१३७॥
घटोत्कचस्य तामाज्ञां प्रतिगृह्याथ राक्षसाः।  दंष्ट्रोज्ज्वला महावक्त्रा घोररूपा भयानकाः॥१३८॥
verses.english: In obedience to that order of Ghatotkacha, the Rakshasas, possessed of blazing teeth, large faces and terrible features, capable of causing dread.

verses.sanskrit: व्यात्तानना घोरजिह्वाः क्रोधताम्रेक्षणा भृशम्।  सिंहनादेन महता नादयन्तो वसुन्धराम्॥१३९॥
हन्तुमभ्यद्रवन्द्रौणिं नानाप्रहरणायुधाः।  शक्तीः शतघ्नीः परिधानशनीः शूलपट्टिशान्॥१४०॥
verses.english: And wielding several (sorts of) weapons rushed to slay the son of Drona. These Rakshasas, of gigantic strength and with eyes reddened with wrath, began to shower upon the head of the son of Drona hundreds and thousands of awfully terrible darts, Sataghness, spiked maces, Asanis, lances, axes, scimitars, maces, Bhindipalas, heavy clubs, battle axes, spears, swords, lances, Kunapas, polished Kampanas, sthulas, Bhushundees, stones. vessels of treacle, sthunas made of black iron and clubs (all) destructive of foes.

verses.sanskrit: खड्गान् गदाभिन्दिपालान् मुसलानि परश्वधान्।  प्रासानसींस्तोमरांश्च कणपान्कम्पनाञ्छितान्॥१४१॥
स्थूलान् भुशुण्ड्यश्मगदास्थूणान् कार्ष्णायसांस्तथा।  मुद्गरांश्च महाघोरान् समरे शत्रुदारणान्॥१४२॥
द्रौणिमूर्धन्यसंत्रस्ता राक्षसा भीमविक्रमाः।  चिक्षिपुः क्रोधताम्राक्षाः शतशोथ सहस्रशः॥१४३॥
verses.english: Seeing that dreadful shower of weapons was falling upon the head of the son of Drona your warriors were greatly distressed (at heart).

verses.sanskrit: तच्छस्त्रवर्षं सुमहद्द्रोणपुत्रस्य मूर्धनि।  पतमानं समीक्ष्याथ योधास्ते व्यथिताऽभवन्॥१४४॥
द्रोणपुत्रस्तु विक्रान्तस्तद्वर्षं घोरमुच्छ्रितम्।  शरैर्विध्वंसयामास वज्रकल्पैः शिलाशितैः॥१४५॥
verses.english: (But) Drona's son dauntlessly baffled that dreadful and impending shower of weapons by means of his own shafts, hard as the thunderbolt and sharpened on stones.

verses.sanskrit: ततोऽन्यौर्विशिखैस्तूर्णं स्वर्णपुंखैर्महामनाः।  निजघ्ने राक्षसान्द्रौणिर्दिव्यास्त्रप्रतिमन्त्रितैः॥१४६॥
verses.english: Then that high-minded son, of Drona, quickly destroyed the Rakshasas with other gold winged shafts inspired with the mantras of celestial weapons.

verses.sanskrit: तद्बाणैरर्दितं यूथं रक्षसां पीनवक्षसाम्।  सिंहैरिव बभौ मत्तं गजानामाकुलं कुलम्॥१४७॥
ते राक्षसाः सुसंक्रुद्धा द्रोणपुत्रेण ताडिताः।  क्रुद्धाः स्म प्राद्रवन्द्रौणिं जिघांसन्तो महाबलाः॥१४८॥
verses.english: Sore oppressed by the son of Drona those Rakshasas, endued with enormous strength, became mad with rage and angrily rushed against Drona's son in order to slay him.

verses.sanskrit: तत्राद्भुतमिमं द्रौणिर्दर्शयामास विक्रमम्।  अशक्यं कर्तुमन्येन सर्वभूतेषु भारत॥१४९॥
verses.english: There, 0 Bharata, the son of Drona displayed such wonderful exploits as are incapable of being achieved by any other being among all the creatures.

verses.sanskrit: यदेको राक्षसीं सेनां क्षणाद्द्रौणिर्महास्त्रवित्।  ददाह ज्वलितैर्बाणै राक्षसेन्द्रस्य पश्यतः॥१५०॥
स हत्वा राक्षसानीकं रराज द्रौणिराहवे।  युगान्ते सर्वभूतानि संवर्तक इवानलः॥१५१॥
verses.english: The son of Drona, while (thus burning that Rakshasa host in battle shone like the Samvartaka fire (consuming) all the creatures at the end of a Yuga.

verses.sanskrit: तं दहन्तमनीकानि शरैराशीविषोपमैः।  तेषु राजसहस्त्रेषु पाण्डवेयेषु भारत॥१५२॥
verses.english: While engaged in consuming the forces with arrows (fierce) as poisonous snakes, among those thousands of kings on the side of the Pandavas, OBharata.

verses.sanskrit: नैनं निरीक्षितुं कश्चिदशक्नोद्द्रौणिमाहवे।  ऋते घटोत्कचाद्वीराद्राक्षसेन्द्रान्महाबलात्॥१५३॥
verses.english: None else could look at the son of Drona in that encounter except Ghatotkacha, the heroic and highly powerful king of the Rakshasas.

verses.sanskrit: स पुनर्भरतश्रेष्ठ क्रोधादुद्भ्रान्तलोचनः।  तलं तलेन संहत्य संदश्य दशनच्छदम्॥१५४॥
स्वं सूतमब्रवीत्क्रुद्धो द्रोणपुत्राय मां वह।  स ययौ घोररूपेण सुपताकेन भास्वता॥१५५॥
verses.english: Said angrily to his charioteer “Bear me towards the son of Drona.” Ascending that terrible looking (car) furnished with triumphal banners, that destroyer foes again marched against the son of Drona in order to engage in a single combat with him. Sending forth a thundering roar like that of a lion, that terriblypowerful Rakshasa, whirling a highly dreadful Asani of celestial make and furnished with eight bells, hurled it in that encounter at the son of Drona.

verses.sanskrit: द्वैरथं द्रोणपुत्रेण पुनरप्यरिसूदनः।  स विनद्य महानादं सिंहवद्भीमविक्रमः॥१५६॥
चिक्षेपाविध्य संग्रामे द्रोणपुत्राय राक्षसः।  अष्टघण्टां महाघोरामशनिं देवनिर्मिताम्॥१५७॥
तामवप्लुत्य जग्राह द्रौणिर्न्यस्य रथे धनुः।  चिक्षेप चैनां तस्यैव स्यन्दनात्सोऽवपुप्लुवे॥१५८॥
साश्वसूतध्वजं यानं भस्म कृत्वा महाप्रभा।  विवेश वसुधां भित्त्वा साऽशनिर्भृशदारुणा॥१५९॥
द्रौणेस्तत्कर्म दृष्ट्वा तु सर्वभूतान्यपूजयन्।  यदवप्लुत्य जग्राह घोरां शङ्करनिर्मिताम्॥१६०॥
verses.english: Seeing the son of Drona achieve that (wonderful) feat all the creatures adored (him) inasmuch as leaping down from his car he seized that (Asani) made by Sankara.

verses.sanskrit: धृष्टद्युम्नरथं गत्वा भैमसेनिस्ततो नृप।  धनुर्घोरं समादाय महदिन्द्रायुधोपमम्।  मुमोच निशितान्बाणान्पुनर्द्रौणेर्महोरसि॥१६१॥
धृष्टद्युम्नस्त्वसंभ्रान्तो मुमोचाशीविषोपमान्।  सुवर्णपुंखान्विशिखान्द्रोणपुत्रस्य वक्षसि॥१६२॥
verses.english: Furnished with gold wings and excellent at the chest of the son of Drona. Thereupon

verses.sanskrit: ततो मुमोच नाराचान्द्रौणिस्तांश्च सहस्रशः।  तावप्यग्निशिखप्रख्यैर्जघ्नतुस्तस्य मार्गणान्॥१६३॥
अतितीव्रं महद्युद्धं तयोः पुरुषसिंहयोः।  योधानां प्रीतिजननं द्रौणेश्च भरतर्षभ॥१६४॥
verses.english: And the son of Drona caused a great delight to the warriors, O best of the Bharatas. Then followed by one thousand cars, three hundred elephants.

verses.sanskrit: ततो रथसहस्त्रेण द्विरदानां शतैस्त्रिभिः।  षड्भिर्वाजिसहस्त्रैश्च भीमस्तं देशमागमत्॥१६५॥
ततो भीमात्मजं रक्षो धृष्टद्युम्नं च सानुगम्।  अयोधयत धर्मात्मा द्रौणिरक्लिष्टविक्रमः॥१६६॥
verses.english: And six thousand steeds Bhimasena made his appearance at that spot (where the battle was raging). But the virtuous-souled son of Drona, possessed of excellent prowess, continued to fight with the heroic son of Bhimasena and Dhristadyumna together with his younger brothers; there the son of Drona achieved the most marvellous exploit.

verses.sanskrit: तत्राद्भुततमं द्रौणिर्दर्शयामास विक्रमम्।  अशक्यं कर्तुमन्येन सर्वभूतेषु भारत॥१६७॥
निमेषान्तरमात्रेण साश्वसूतरथद्विपाम्।  अक्षौहिणीं राक्षसानां शितैर्बाणैरशातयत्॥१६८॥
मिषतो भीमसेनस्य हैडिम्बेः पार्षतस्य च।  यमयोर्धर्मपुत्रस्य विजयस्याच्युतस्य च॥१६९॥
प्रगाढमञ्जोगतिभिर्नाराचैरभिताडिताः।  निपेतुर्द्विरदा भूमौ सशृङ्गा इव पर्वताः॥१७०॥
निकृत्तैर्हस्तिहस्तैश्च विचलद्भिरितस्ततः।  रराज वसुधा कीर्णा विसर्पद्भिरिवोरगैः॥१७१॥
क्षिप्तैः काञ्चनदण्डैश्च नृपच्छत्रैः क्षितिर्बभौ।  द्यौरिवोदितचन्द्रार्का ग्रहाकीर्णा युगक्षये॥१७२॥
प्रवृद्धध्वजमण्डूकां भेरीविस्तीर्णकच्छपाम्।  छत्रहंसावलीजुष्टां फेनचामरमालिनीम्॥१७३॥
कङ्कगृध्रमहाग्राहां नैकायुधझषाकुलाम्।  विस्तीर्णगजपाषाणां हताश्वमकराकुलाम्॥१७४॥
verses.english: Huge elephants the stones, elephants and horses the sharks, cars the unstable and great banks, flags the beautiful trees.

verses.sanskrit: रथक्षिप्तमहावप्रां पताकारुचिरद्रुमाम्।  शरमीनां महारौद्रां प्रासशक्त्यृष्टिडुण्डुभाम्॥१७५॥
मज्जामांसमहापङ्कां कबन्धावर्जितोडुपाम्।  केशशैवलकल्माषां भीरूणां कश्मलावहाम्॥१७६॥
नागेन्द्रहययोधानां शरीरव्ययसंभवाम्। शोणितौघमहाघोरां द्रौणिः प्रावर्तयन्नदीम्॥१७७॥
योधार्तरवनिर्घोषां क्षतजोर्मिसमाकुलाम्।  श्वापदातिमहाघोरां यमराष्ट्रमहोदधिम्॥१७८॥
verses.english: (It looked) frightful with the (dead) bodies of foot soldiers and (it flowed towards) that great ocean, that is, the abode of Yama. Having destroyed the Rakshasa the son of Hidimva with shafts.

verses.sanskrit: निहत्य राक्षसान्बाणैर्द्रौणिर्हैडिम्बिमार्दयत्।  पुनरप्यतिसंक्रुद्धः सवृकोदरपार्षतान्॥१७९॥
verses.english: Waxing worth again, Drona's son having pierced with numerous shafts those great carwarriors, the of Pritha including Vrikodara and the son of Prishata.

verses.sanskrit: स नाराचगणैः पार्थान्द्रौणिर्विद्ध्वा महाबलः।  जघान सुरथं नाम द्रुपदस्य सुतं विभुः॥१८०॥
पुनः शत्रुञ्जयं नाम द्रुपदस्यात्मजं रणे।  बलानीकं जयानीकं जयाश्वं चाभिजघ्निवान्॥१८१॥
श्रुताह्वयं च राजानं द्रौणिर्निन्ये यमक्षयम्।  त्रिभिश्चान्यैः शरैस्तीक्ष्णैः सुपुङ्खैर्हेममालिनम्॥१८२॥
जघान स पृषध्रं च चन्द्रसेनं च मारिष।  कुन्तिभोजसुतांश्चासौ दशभिर्दश जघ्निवान्॥१८३॥
अश्वत्थामा सुसंक्रुद्धः सन्धायोग्रमजिह्मगम्।  मुमोचाकर्णपूर्णेन धनुषा शरमुत्तमम्॥१८४॥
verses.english: Slew Prishadhru and the proud Chandrasena. (Then) with ten (darts) he destroyed ten sons of Kuntibhoja with another three red-eyed arrow graced with beautiful wings he dispatched O king of kings, to the abode of Yama, Shtrutayush. (He then) sent the powerful Satrunjaya to the abode of Shakra. Ashvatthama, then, greatly enraged, fixed a terrible and uncrooked (arrows) (on his bowstring). (And) drawing the string up to his very ear, he soon discharged from his bow that excellent and formidable (arrow) looking like Yamadanda at Ghatotkacha.

verses.sanskrit: यमदण्डोपमं घोरमुद्दिश्याशु घटोत्कचम्।  स भित्त्वा हृदयं तस्य राक्षसस्य महाशरः॥१८५॥
विवेश वसुधां शीघ्रं सपुङ्खः पृथिवीपते।  तं हतं पतितं ज्ञात्वा धृष्टद्युम्नो महारथः॥१८६॥
verses.english: Seeing him fallen down and taking him for dead, the great car-warrior Dhristadyumna. placed him upon another car and bore him away from the presence of the son of Drona, O king kings.

verses.sanskrit: द्रौणेः सकाशाद्राजेन्द्र व्यपनिन्ये रथोत्तमम्।  ततः पराङ्मुखनृपं सैन्यं यौधिष्ठिरं नृप॥१८७॥
verses.english: Thus the car-warriors of Yudhishthira were driven back O king. Vanquishing his enemies, the heroic son of Drona uttered thundering shouts and he was adored by all men and by your sons, O lord.

verses.sanskrit: पराजित्य रणे वीरो द्रोणपुत्रो ननाद ह।  पूजितः सर्वभूतेषु तव पुत्रैश्च भारत॥१८८॥
अथ शरशतभिन्नकृत्तदेहैर्हतपतितैः क्षणदाचरैः समन्तात्।  निधनमुपगतैर्मही कृताऽभूद्गिरिशिखरैरिव दुर्गमाऽतिरौद्रा॥१८९॥
तं सिद्धगन्धर्वपिशाचसंघा नागाः सुपर्णाः पितरो वयांसि।  रक्षोगणा भूतगणाश्च द्रौणिमपूजयन्नप्सरसः सुराश्च॥१९०॥
